scope: offline adapter from fast-cycle in-memory inputs to measurement v2, test fixture alignment, no production integration
frame: immutable cycleAt/completedAt and per-market observedAt/monotonic read sequence; raw bands, pre-update models, post-update persistence, original decisions and post-update daily model
clockPolicy: never infer receipt times from data.json; band read time stays observedAt; validated current-frame derived EMA gets evidence time completedAt with original modelAt retained
phaseChecks: recompute unchanged policzInwestycje and aktualizujPoziomyD on copies and require exact parity; do not modify original recommendations or models
dedup: atomic per-frame processing, repeat identical frame idempotent, reject changed reused frame/cycle/time or receipt sequence
legacyPolicy: existing frozen archive remains separate and excluded from v2; no automatic live migration; open legacy handoff remains explicit deployment decision
momentum: no rating inference, remain excluded unless a separate proven enriched source is supplied in a later stage
testAlignment: update only tkontrolki.mjs fixture units, historical expectations and warning/no-error assertions to match documented existing controls; no guard or recommendation threshold changes
realDataCheck: reconstruct original archived 154-card cohort to exercise shapes and compare six decisions; receipt clocks in that replay are declared synthetic and do not prove live acquisition timing
exclusions: claiming live timing proof from reconstructed receipt metadata
